description: This file contains the FastAPI routes and logic for handling Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication in the LiteLLM proxy server. It manages login redirects, callback processing, user and team creation/updating, and health checks related to SSO providers such as Google, Microsoft, and Generic OAuth providers. It also includes utilities for generating and verifying JWTs for CLI sessions, handling PKCE flows, and ensuring proper environment configuration.

classes.name: SSOAuthenticationHandler
classes.description: Contains static methods for managing SSO login redirects, callback processing, user creation and validation, environment configuration validation, and team management. Handles different SSO providers (Google, Microsoft, generic) and implements PKCE flows, environment checks, and user identity management consistent with the LiteLLM proxy's security and user management policies.
